result.document_summary: A Boston.gov page describing the Fair Housing Commission's enforcement of local, state and federal fair housing laws, including a ban on housing discrimination based on rental assistance such as Section 8 vouchers.
result.notes: The page is a general fair housing overview and cites no ordinance or statute. The only in-scope rule is the protection against source-of-income (rental assistance) discrimination, recorded under screening_restrictions. No effective date, coverage conditions or exemptions are stated. The page's list of protected classes and complaint process are outside the six categories and were not extracted.

rules.title: Rental assistance (source-of-income) discrimination prohibited
rules.requirement: Landlords in Boston may not discriminate against tenants or applicants because they use rental assistance, including Section 8 vouchers, social security disability vouchers and veterans vouchers. Telling an applicant the landlord does not accept rental assistance is cited as an example of housing discrimination.
rules.key_value: Rental assistance is a protected class
rules.citation: Boston Fair Housing Commission fair housing regulations (law not named on page)
rules.quoted_span:
The landlord tells you they don't accept rental assistance. This includes Section
8 vouchers, social security disability vouchers, and veterans vouchers.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to renting, buying, selling or securing financing for any housing in the City of Boston; no further coverage tests are stated.
rules.interaction: The page says the commission enforces local, state and federal fair housing laws, but it does not say how this rule interacts with any specific law.
